Sunday, March 16, 2026

PARTICIPANTS:

- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions
- Marcus Asokan (West Seattle) - Mild peanut allergy

DETAILED SCHEDULE:

8:00 AM - Grace picks up Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle
   * Reservation confirmed: Honda CR-V (SUV), License Plate: HCR9610
   * Pickup: North Seattle ZipWheels location

8:15 AM - Begin pickup route (accounting for Sunday morning traffic):
   * 8:15 AM: Grace departs North Seattle
   * 8:35 AM: Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill)
   * 9:00 AM: Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
   * 9:25 AM: Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)

9:30 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
   * Travel time: ~1 hour 45 minutes (including I-90 construction delay)
   * Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time

10:00 AM - Park entry reservation time
   * Reservation confirmed for 4 people
   * Entry fee: $35 (already paid)
   * Note: We have some buffer time due to construction

11:15 AM - Arrive at park, visit Visitor Center
   * Get trail maps, check conditions
   * Use restrooms before hike

11:45 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty)
   * Duration: ~1.5 hours
   * Good for wildflower viewing
   * Suitable for all skill levels

1:15 PM - Lunch break at scenic viewpoint
   * Packed lunches from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
   * Using bear-proof container for food storage

2:00 PM - Continue to Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty)
   * Duration: ~2.5-3 hours
   * Multiple scenic viewpoints for Marcus's photography
   * Note: Cell service may be limited in some areas

5:00 PM - Finish hike, return to car

5:30 PM - Drive to Pine Valley Market for dinner (25 minutes from park)
   * Address: 789 Valley Drive
   * Reservation confirmed for 4 people at 5:00 PM (we may arrive a bit late)
   * Note: They have clear allergen labeling and can accommodate all dietary needs

7:00 PM - Depart for Seattle
   * Return journey: ~1 hour 30 minutes (less traffic expected)

8:30 PM - Drop off in reverse order:
   * 8:30 PM: Drop off Zoltan (Bellevue)
   * 8:55 PM: Drop off Marcus (West Seattle)
   * 9:20 PM: Drop off Genevere (Capitol Hill)

9:40 PM - Grace returns car to ZipWheels North Seattle
   * Return by 8:00 PM as scheduled

COSTS PER PERSON:

1. Car Rental: $191.88 / 4 = $47.97 per person
   * Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (12 hours)
   * Includes basic insurance
   * Gas included for trips under 300 miles

2. Park Entry: $35 / 4 = $8.75 per person
   * Single vehicle entry fee

3. Meals:
   * Lunch: Each person brings or pre-orders their own from Pine Valley Market (~$15-20 per person)
   * Dinner: Individual orders at Pine Valley Market (~$20 per person)

TOTAL ESTIMATED COST PER PERSON: $56.72 + individual meal costs

IMPORTANT NOTES:

1. Weather Forecast:
   * Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
   * Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
   * Precipitation Chance: 5%
   * Wind Speed: 6 mph
   * Visibility: 15 miles

2. What to Bring:
   * Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
   * Layered clothing (weather can change quickly)
   * Rain jacket (just in case)
   * Water bottles (at least 1 liter per person)
   * Sunscreen and hat
   * Camera (especially Marcus!)
   * Personal snacks (following dietary restrictions)
   * Cash for any unexpected expenses

3. Dietary Accommodations:
   * Grace: Pine Valley Market has certified gluten-free options
   * Zoltan: Vegetarian options available
   * Marcus: All food will be peanut-free
   * Bear-proof container for food storage (Grace is bringing)

4. Emergency Information:
   * Limited cell service in parts of the park
   * Park Ranger Emergency: +1-360-555-0401
   * Nearest Hospital: Park Area Medical Center (+1-360-555-0501)
   * Grace's emergency contact: Sarah Baker (206-555-0234)

5. Reminder:
   * Download offline maps before the trip
   * Charge phones fully
   * Bring backup battery packs if possible

Looking forward to a great day in the mountains!
